mission.headline: Helping you achieve your fitness potential is my mission.
mission.author: Mike Vasquez

whoIAm.body: My approach combines science-backed training techniques with personalized workout plans designed specifically for your goals—building muscle, losing weight, or improving overall health.
whoIAm.imageAlt: Personal trainer coaching a client with dumbbells

aboutPage.name: Mike Vasquez
aboutPage.headline: Strength, discipline, and habits that last beyond the gym.
aboutPage.lead: I help people build strength, confidence, and lasting habits with clear programming, honest coaching, and plans that fit real life—not temporary motivation.
aboutPage.leadSecondary: Whether you are starting fresh, returning after a break, or leveling up as an athlete, I build a path you can actually follow week after week.
aboutPage.metaBody: Programming, nutrition guidance, and accountability in one clear system.

story.title: Coaching built on results, not trends
story.p1: For more than 14 years I’ve coached beginners, athletes, and busy professionals who want real change—not another random workout they abandon in two weeks.
story.p2: I started as a trainer who loved the science of training. What kept me in this work is watching people discover what their body can do when the plan is clear, progressive, and personal.
story.p3: Today I combine strength training, conditioning, and practical nutrition guidance so you know exactly what to do, why it works, and how to stay consistent.

pillars.title: A simple system that actually sticks
pillars.subtitle: Every program is built around three non-negotiables so progress feels measurable and sustainable.

method.title: Smart programming
method.body: Workouts progress with intention—right volume, right intensity, and clear weekly structure matched to your level and schedule.

nutrition.title: Practical nutrition
nutrition.body: No extreme diets. Just food strategies you can follow at home, at work, and on busy days while still moving toward your goal.

accountability.title: Real accountability
accountability.body: Check-ins, form feedback, and plan adjustments keep you moving forward when motivation dips and life gets loud.

items.health: Improve energy, posture, and daily health
items.athletes: Train with structure as a young athlete or adult

closing.title: Ready to start your next chapter?
closing.body: Tell me your goal and I’ll help you choose the right path—training, nutrition, or a full coaching package.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.pageSubtitle: Everything you need to know about plans, sessions, and coaching support.

plan.q: How do I choose the right plan for me?
plan.a: We recommend starting with a consultation to discuss your fitness goals and preferences. This way, we can tailor a plan that suits your individual needs.

missed.q: What if I miss a scheduled training session?
missed.a: If you miss a scheduled training session, please contact your trainer as soon as possible to discuss rescheduling options. We understand that life can be unpredictable, and we are here to help you stay on track with your fitness goals.

switch.q: Can I switch my plan later?
switch.a: Yes, you can switch your plan at any time. We understand that your needs may change, and we are flexible in accommodating those changes to ensure you have the best experience.

support.q: How do I contact my trainer for support?
support.a: You can contact your trainer for support by sending them an email or a message through the training app. They are available to assist you with any questions or concerns you may have.

commit.a: No, there are no long-term commitments required. You have the flexibility to choose a plan that fits your current needs and can adjust or cancel at any time.
